summaries.en: Requires SoloPlay and Havoc Condition Manager; supports Realms. Edit generators, pools and caps. Name, save, load and share player templates as JSON, with a dedicated folder and confirmation before deleting a template. English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
summaries.zh-CN: 以SoloPlay和浩劫词条管理器为前提，支持Realms。编辑生成器、池子与容量；新增玩家模板库，可命名保存、加载、通过JSON分享及导入，并在显示模板名称的弹窗中确认删除。提供英文、简体中文与繁体中文。
summaries.zh-TW: 以SoloPlay及浩劫詞條管理器為前提，支援Realms。編輯生成器、池子及容量；新增玩家範本庫，可命名儲存、載入、透過JSON分享及匯入，並在顯示範本名稱的彈窗中確認刪除。提供英文、簡體中文及繁體中文。

main_file_description: Requires SoloPlay and Havoc Condition Manager; supports Realms. Edit generators, pools and caps. Name, save, load and share player templates as JSON, with a dedicated folder and confirmation before deleting a template. English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
